import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a comprehensive figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
sleep_disorder_mapping = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
for i, disorder in enumerate(sleep_disorder_mapping.unique()):
    mask = sleep_disorder_mapping == disorder
    ax1.scatter(df[mask]['Sleep Duration'], df[mask]['Quality of Sleep'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=60, label=disorder, color=colors[i])
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Average Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values()
top_occupations = occupation_sleep.tail(10)
ax2.barh(range(len(top_occupations)), top_occupations.values, color=sns.color_palette("viridis", len(top_occupations)))
ax2.set_yticks(range(len(top_occupations)))
ax2.set_yticklabels(top_occupations.index, fontsize=8)
ax2.set_xlabel('Avg Sleep Duration (hrs)', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Top 10 Occupations\nby Sleep Duration', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Physical Activity vs Stress Level
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
scatter = ax3.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Stress Level'], 
                     c=df['Quality of Sleep'], cmap='RdYlGn', s=50, alpha=0.6)
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Stress Level', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Physical Activity vs Stress\n(colored by Sleep Quality)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax3)
cbar.set_label('Sleep Quality', fontsize=9)
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 4. BMI Category Distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
colors_bmi = sns.color_palette("Set2", len(bmi_counts))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors_bmi, startangle=90)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
    autotext.set_fontsize(9)
for text in texts:
    text.set_fontsize(9)
ax4.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Sleep Disorder Distribution by Gender
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
disorder_gender = pd.crosstab(df['Gender'], df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None'))
disorder_gender.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax5, color=colors[:len(disorder_gender.columns)], width=0.7)
ax5.set_xlabel('Gender', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Sleep Disorders by Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', fontsize=8, title_fontsize=9)
ax5.set_xticklabels(ax5.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
ax5.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 6. Heart Rate vs Daily Steps
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
ax6.hexbin(df['Daily Steps'], df['Heart Rate'], gridsize=20, cmap='YlOrRd', mincnt=1)
ax6.set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Heart Rate vs Daily Steps\n(Density)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 7. Age Distribution by Sleep Disorder
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
sleep_disorders = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None').unique()
age_data = [df[df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None') == disorder]['Age'].values 
            for disorder in sleep_disorders]
bp = ax7.boxplot(age_data, labels=sleep_disorders, patch_artist=True)
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], colors[:len(sleep_disorders)]):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
    patch.set_alpha(0.7)
ax7.set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_ylabel('Age', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_title('Age Distribution by\nSleep Disorder', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=8, rotation=15)
ax7.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 8. Correlation heatmap
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', center=0, 
            square=True, ax=ax8, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8}, annot_kws={'fontsize': 7})
ax8.set_title('Feature Correlations', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=8)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
